# Getting Help

🇫🇷 [Version française](./SUPPORT.fr.md)

ThyroTrack is a personal project, maintained by a single person in their spare time: there is no commercial support and no response-time guarantee. It is **not a medical device** and gives no medical advice.

## Before asking for help

1. Check [docs/troubleshooting.md](../docs/troubleshooting.md) — cases already encountered (CI, lockfile, test runner and Node versions) are documented there, with the diagnostic steps that were followed.
2. Check `GET /health` on the service ([thyrotrack.alithiel31.dev/health](https://thyrotrack.alithiel31.dev/health)) — confirms whether the backend responds before you report an outage.
3. Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/Alithiel31/ThyFollow/issues), open and closed.

## Reporting a bug or requesting a feature

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Alithiel31/ThyFollow/issues/new/choose) — the templates ask for the useful context (backend or frontend, environment, steps to reproduce, logs). **Never put real health data, a token or a password in an issue**: strip them from logs and screenshots first.

## Contributing

Development environment, reproducing the CI locally, commit conventions: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Reporting a security vulnerability

**Do not** use this channel for a security flaw — see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md), which describes private reporting via GitHub Security Advisories.
